chapter.title: Chapter Ten: The Rent Party
chapter.subtitle: Everybody can fundraise. Nobody can agree how.
chapter.description: The block throws three fundraisers at once and nearly spends the proceeds before collecting them.

tips: Listen for the terms before the first contest.

scenes.speaker: Bottle Girl
scenes.text: I booked a rent party, a fish fry, and a silent auction. Unfortunately they are all in the same hour.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: The auction is not silent. Roaster is heckling a lamp.

scenes.speaker: All Jokes Roaster
scenes.text: That lamp knows what it did.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: Money has one purpose: inspection repairs and a community-use deposit if the owner agrees.

scenes.speaker: Baby Momma
scenes.text: You made colors again. Tear them in half and write RECEIPT on both sides.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: That is why it may work.

tips: Its result settles only the stated event term.

starObjectives.description: Move at least one of your cards.

preDialogue.speaker: Bottle Girl
preDialogue.text: Winner runs the serving lane; loser keeps the fryer line moving.

preDialogue.speaker: Church Auntie
preDialogue.text: And nobody calls grease smoke ambience.

preDialogue.speaker: All Jokes Roaster
preDialogue.text: I brought premium tartar sauce in a mustard bottle.

preDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma

preDialogue.speaker: Bottle Girl
preDialogue.text: Label it later. Serve now. Line getting long.

postDialogue.speaker: Bottle Girl
postDialogue.text: Serving lane is yours. We cleared enough for the electrician's deposit.

postDialogue.speaker: Church Auntie
postDialogue.text: Count it twice, then wash your hands twice.

phases.name: Public Pressure
phases.description: At round three, the opponent gains 1 Motion.

phases.name: Late Arrival
phases.description: At round 6, the opponent draws one card from its remaining ten-card deck. If the deck is empty, no card is added.

passive.name: Announced Terms
passive.description: The final table escalates once without changing the agreement outside the match.

preDialogue.speaker: Ganger Blue
preDialogue.text: Last table decides whether my livestream marathon or Wifey's repair list gets top billing.

preDialogue.speaker: Wifey
preDialogue.text: The money follows the published list either way. We are playing for the microphone.

preDialogue.speaker: Baby Momma
preDialogue.text: Say it again for the people trained by last season.

preDialogue.text: Cards decide the microphone. Receipts decide the money. Damn, I heard myself grow.

postDialogue.text: Read every expense, including your twelve-dollar metallic marker.

postDialogue.speaker: Cornball

postDialogue.text: Collateral accepted. Now count the rest out loud so everybody hear the real number.

tips: The match result and the real-world agreement remain separate.

scenes.speaker: Bottle Girl
scenes.text: After food costs, we have the electrician's deposit and enough for safety rail materials.

scenes.speaker: Baby Momma
scenes.text: Not enough for a purchase offer. Say the number without dressing it up.

scenes.speaker: Ganger Blue
scenes.text: Three thousand, two hundred, eighteen dollars and a Canadian quarter.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: The quarter is earmarked for international expansion.

scenes.speaker: Wifey
scenes.text: It is earmarked for the jar.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: I missed teardown once. Not tonight. Point me at the tables.

scenes.speaker: Baby Momma
scenes.text: Start with the one your child covered in removable stickers.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: Removable by whom? These got structural confidence.

scenes.speaker: OG Uncle
scenes.text: You showed up for teardown. Keep doing that when there isn’t a camera.

scenes.speaker: Church Auntie
scenes.text: Tomorrow we repair the roof. Tonight, take home the fish before Cornball auctions it again.
